AllowanceLine.title: AllowanceLine
AllowanceLine.description: A cost outside the BOM (permits, soil, survey, utilities, fees). Baseline until real figures exist.

BudgetProposal.title: BudgetProposal
BudgetProposal.description: The estimator proposes a budget; the owner accepts it or rejects it for a cheaper option.

CalcStep.title: CalcStep
CalcStep.description: One step of a calculation, shown as a row in the UI: what was done, with what, and the result.

cost_per_m2_excl_vat_sar.title: Cost Per M2 Excl Vat Sar

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

extracted.title: Extracted

missing_fields.title: Missing Fields
missing_fields.description: Inputs the engine needs but the text did not give

assumed_defaults.title: Assumed Defaults
assumed_defaults.description: Defaults used where the text was silent

PermitView.title: PermitView
PermitView.description: A permit step with its baseline cost and the documents uploaded so far.

ProjectDocument.title: ProjectDocument
ProjectDocument.description: A file the owner uploaded against a permit or soil step. Metadata only for now.

ProjectInput.title: ProjectInput

ProjectRecord.title: ProjectRecord
